name: Katsura Keima
source:
Chief pilot of the "Kubo Air Transport". A legendary pilot who was a test pilot of the original “Breaking the High Altitude Limits Development Project - Ikaros” and challenged “The Sky of the Goddess” five years ago with the test machine “X-101” – commonly known as “Ikaros 13”.

It is said he's the only man who has passed the thermosphere and has "spent" time in the catastrophe... After the Ikaros Project, he started making a living with the "Kubo Air Transport".

Because he has all the "right qualities" for being reliable at steering and technology, unfortunatley he has a hars "sulky personality" and women philandering habits. His tuck test pilot name was "KK". His favorite drink is a 10 year Bush Mills Irish Whiskey Single Malt.

"...If you want to quit, you can do it. I don't want to take care of children."
